sh.ready.text: Hi, I'm Zephy! Will you help me fly through the sky hoops?

sh.back.text: Welcome back, co-pilot! The hoops are waiting.

sh.story.intro1.text: Meet Zephy. She has big wings and an even bigger dream.

sh.story.intro2.text: Today is the Sky Hoop Show, and Zephy is flying the little red plane.

sh.story.intro3.text: But which way do the controls go? Bobbo is too nervous to watch!

sh.story.intro4.text: Help Zephy fly through every hoop.

sh.story.between2.text: Whoosh! Two hoops. Bobbo peeks out.

sh.story.between4.text: The crowd is cheering. The hoops are getting trickier!

sh.story.between6.text: Last part of the course. Steady hands!

sh.story.outro2.text: You knew which way to move each control.

sh.prompt.tutorial.text: The hoop is up high. Pull the stick back to lift the nose!

sh.prompt.hoop.text: The hoop is {where}. Fly through it!

sh.prompt.name.text: Watch the plane. How did it move?

sh.prompt.line.text: Zephy is rolling down the runway. The nose drifts {side}. Steer it straight!

sh.prompt.turn.text: The next hoop is far to the {side}. What does Zephy do first?

sh.prompt.level.text: Level, at a steady speed. Which picture shows the forces?

sh.prompt.faster.text: Zephy wants to speed up. Which picture shows the forces?

sh.prompt.slower.text: Zephy wants to slow down. Which picture shows the forces?

sh.prompt.down.text: Which force pulls the plane down?

sh.prompt.up.text: Which force holds the plane up?

sh.prompt.course.text: Plan all three moves, then press Fly!

sh.opt.pitch.text: Pitch. The nose tips up or down.

sh.opt.yaw.text: Yaw. The nose swings left or right.

sh.opt.elevator.text: Elevator. The flap at the back of the little tail wings.

sh.opt.ailerons.text: Ailerons. The flaps near the wing tips.

sh.opt.rudder.text: Rudder. The tall flap at the back of the tail.

sh.opt.balanced.text: Lift equals weight, and thrust equals drag.

sh.opt.lift.text: Lift. It pushes up on the wings.

sh.opt.thrust.text: Thrust. The propeller pulls the plane forward.

sh.opt.drag.text: Drag. The air holds the plane back.

sh.help.pitch.text: Pull the stick back and the tail goes down, so the nose goes up!

sh.help.roll.text: Move the stick left and the wings tip left. That's a roll.

sh.help.yaw.text: Press a pedal and the nose swings that way. That's yaw.

sh.help.turn.text: In the air, planes turn by tipping their wings, like a leaning bike.

sh.help.taxi.text: On the ground, the pedals steer the nose wheel. Push the side you want.

sh.help.forces.text: Lift holds the plane up, weight pulls down, thrust pushes forward, drag holds back.

sh.help.parts.text: Elevator on the tail wings, ailerons near the wingtips, rudder on the tall fin.

sh.help.stick.text: Back is nose up, forward is nose down. Left and right tip the wings.

sh.help.axes.text: Pitch is nose up or down. Roll tips the wings. Yaw swings the nose.

sh.help.lift.text: The wings push air down, and the air pushes the wings up. That's lift!

sh.help.course.text: One hoop at a time. Look where each hoop is, then pick the move.

sh.hint.rollYaw.text: Roll tips the wings. Yaw swings the nose. Watch the wings!

sh.hint.elevator.text: Back and forward move the elevator, on the little tail wings.

sh.hint.ailerons.text: Left and right move the ailerons, near the wing tips.

sh.hint.rudder.text: The pedals move the rudder, the tall flap on the tail.

sh.hint.stickTips.text: On the ground, the stick just moves the wing flaps. The pedals steer.

sh.hint.boat.text: In the air, a pedal alone skids the nose. Tip the wings to turn.

sh.hint.steady.text: Steady speed means thrust and drag are equal. Nothing needs to win.

sh.hint.liftEq.text: If lift were bigger than weight, Zephy would start going up. Level means equal.

sh.hint.faster.text: Thrust pushes forward, drag holds back. Which must be bigger to speed up?

sh.hint.slower.text: Thrust pushes forward, drag holds back. Which must be bigger to slow down?

sh.hint.dragBack.text: Drag holds the plane back, not down.

sh.hint.liftUp.text: Lift pushes up on the wings. What pulls everything down to the ground?

sh.hint.engine.text: The propeller pulls Zephy forward. The wings make the lift.

sh.hint.model.text: Look for the glowing answer, then press it.

sh.retry.1.text: The plane went another way. Let's try again.

sh.praise.up.text: Nose up, right through the hoop!

sh.praise.down.text: Nose down, right through the hoop!

sh.praise.roll.text: You tipped the wings, right through the hoop!

sh.praise.turn.text: You tipped the wings to turn.

sh.praise.yaw.text: You steered with the pedal, straight down the runway!

sh.praise.is.pitch.text: You saw the nose tip. That's pitch!

sh.praise.is.roll.text: You saw the wings tip. That's roll!

sh.praise.is.yaw.text: You saw the nose swing. That's yaw!

sh.praise.part.elevator.text: You spotted the elevator moving on the tail!

sh.praise.part.ailerons.text: You spotted the ailerons moving on the wings!

sh.praise.part.rudder.text: You spotted the rudder moving on the tail!

sh.idle.text: Take your time. Watch the plane, then choose.
